title: toktier chunked admission table
description: The chunk-parallel path's (toktier.chunked) admission table: one row per roster family and artifact digest with recorded chunked-path evidence. A row is certified only when both levels of chunked-path evidence exist for the Python path, the adversarial normalization battery and the corpus cut campaign; a row with one level carries that as its status and is refused at run time like an absent row. paths names the paths (python, native) whose evidence is complete at both levels. Generated by tools/update_chunked_admission.py from readings/chunked_cuts_campaign.json and shipped inside the package. chunked_identity binds the Python path to the source it was recorded on, fast_cpu_source_digest_v2 the native path to the engine's version-normalized identity. Hand edits are rejected by --check.

loader_face_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the loader-face document the evidence was taken on; the module refuses a tokenizer whose live loader face hashes differently (a loader version that materializes another pre-tokenizer is not the certified face). Null when the readings did not record it.

status.description: certified: the Python path was judged by both the adversarial battery and the corpus campaign; adversarial_only / corpus_only: one level is recorded, the row is refused at run time.

paths.description: Paths whose evidence is complete at both levels; empty for a row that is not certified.

evidence.description: The evidence levels recorded per path, complete or not.
